name: customer-health-mcp
description: MCP server that synthesizes mock billing, support, and product usage data into B2B SaaS customer health and churn-risk insights.
long_description: Answers customer-success questions like "which accounts are at risk of churning?" by synthesizing three data sources shaped like real B2B SaaS systems: Stripe-style billing/subscriptions, Zendesk/Intercom-style support tickets, and product-analytics-style usage. Includes a weighted, documented risk-scoring engine that explains its drivers rather than returning an opaque number. All data is deterministic synthetic data generated at startup - no external accounts or API keys required.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all customer accounts with plan, MRR, payment status, and computed churn-risk band. Supports optional filtering by plan and payment status.

tools.name: get_account_details
tools.description: Fetch the complete raw record for one account: billing/subscription record, 90-day usage time series and feature adoption, and full support ticket history.

tools.name: list_at_risk_accounts
tools.description: List accounts whose churn-risk band is at or above a minimum threshold, sorted by risk score descending.

tools.name: get_account_risk_summary
tools.description: Compute an account's churn-risk score and band, list the specific drivers behind the number, and generate a human-readable summary.
